subject: Waiver Request: automated revert + sticky-version for progressive A/B launch — EdgeNova POC
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Waiver Request: automated revert + sticky-version for progressive A/B launch — EdgeNova POC

Team —

We have a scheduled progressive A/B launch for EdgeNova (POC) on Thu 2028-05-04. The plan is to shift 20% of production traffic to the new model variant (rwd-infer-edge-v2-q4f) behind an A/B gate with session stickiness. EdgeNova is requesting two temporary controls as a condition of going live:

1) automated-revert (auto-fallback) on safety/availability regressions (immediate fallback to baseline model when error-rate or model-failure spike crosses thresholds);
2) session sticky-version (pinning) so in-flight user sessions consistently hit the same model variant for experiment validity.

Ask: permission to grant a limited SLA carveout (waiver) that allows us to keep the A/B gate open with the above controls active. Proposed gating criteria in the attached MOP:
- immediate autorevert if request error rate > 1.5% sustained for 3 minutes OR 5xx spike > 1%
- autorevert if 95th percentile token latency increases by > 120ms vs baseline (3m rolling)
- sticky-version for any session that receives >=1 generated token during the experiment (TTL 24 hours)

Risks: increased latency variability during ramp; transient cost bump while telemetry warms up. Mitigations: continuous tracing, dual-model canary traffic (warm caches), and a hard safety kill-switch we control.

Attachments: edge_nova_mop.pdf (MOP), canary-metrics.csv (baseline metrics). Also linking the proposed waiver template.

We need an expedited approval to present to EdgeNova and procurement — they want a signed acknowledgement by Wed EOD. Priyom — can you validate the autorevert thresholds and confirm instrumentation? Lauren — can you OK the commercial-side waiver & pricing implications? Aditya — if SRE accepts thresholds, please sign-off and we’ll route to procurement for DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Approved SLA waiver (EdgeNova POC) — autorevert & sticky-version parameters

Team / Sarah / Maria —

We reviewed instrumentation and runbook updates overnight. SRE authorizes the temporary waiver with the following final controls (effective 2028-05-04 00:00 UTC for a 72-hour window):

- Autorevert triggers:
  * request error rate > 1.5% sustained for 2 minutes OR
  * 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 2 minutes OR
  * 95th percentile token latency increase > 120ms vs baseline (3-minute rolling window)
- Sticky-version behavior:
  * Sessions that receive >=1 generated token will be pinned to the variant for 24 hours (TTL configurable, default 24h)
- Owner & escalation:
  * On-call SRE: rwd-sre-pager (escalation policy attached to runbook)
  * Rollback owner: Marcus Lin (Account Exec) + Lauren Bishop (VP Sales) for commercial notices
- Cost clause: EdgeNova will be billed at the agreed POC rate for incremental inference consumption during the 72-hour window.

Actions completed:
- I attached the signed waiver template and created the DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/EN-D-87234-sign
- Attachments: sla-waiver-template.docx (signed copy), edge_nova_mop.pdf (finalized), canary-metrics.csv (baseline).

Marcus — please send the DocuSign invite to Maria (procurement) and Sarah; I'll mark the waiver as authorized on our internal side.
